reviews.text:
I found an exceptional combination of professionalism, attention to my cat's well-being and emotions, and attention to detail. Participating was a very interesting experience, which taught me aspects of Matisse's behavior that I hadn't known before.

DON'T MISS

Today we had the pleasure of taking our Serse to this wonderful place for his first bath. The owners are truly delightful, so much so that Serse didn't want to leave! The service is attentive, precise, and impeccable, and you can tell the girls love their job and all their furry clients. We'll definitely be back! Valeria, Dario, and Serse!
Excellent service, friendly and helpful staff. Recommended.

For the first time today my cat was professionally "skinscarred"...
Isabella is a professional who knows her way around animals... she cuddled the cat and acted with gentleness and care...
Super satisfied...
We'll be back for her first shower.
Thank you!

Today I took my dog ​​to Il Peloso for the first time. I was greeted by the owner, Isabella, who, even before being a groomer, I knew was an animal lover from the moment we spoke on the phone. I handed her a dog with very long, tangled fur, and she handed me back a Princess. This is because, even before being a job, I consider it almost a mission for our little animals. It must be done with love and dedication. Thank you, Isabella ☺️
Today I took my cat to his first bath, they were very kind, they have a lot of patience and they are very caring, thank you 💖

My poodle was treated like a princess, so much so that she didn't want to leave! 😂 We had a previous traumatic experience at another groomer, and Isabella, with her gentle manner, managed to calm the dog down, so much so that she even managed to clean her ears, which is extremely difficult at home! Met by chance, excellent work, and a fair price for a "demanding" dog like a giant poodle, we couldn't have found ourselves better!!! See you soon 😁 🐾

Loki found new friends today. He's a reserved poodle, but he immediately felt at home here.
As a "human," I found great professionalism and passion.
A decidedly positive experience.
There will be many more visits.

The girls were really good and very sweet with my cat 🥰 They managed to remove all the knots with so much patience and delicacy, making her feel at ease. Super professional, attentive, and kind: highly recommended!
Prepared, competent, patient, in short everything perfect ❤️
Professionalism, cleanliness, and kindness are hard to find. Carmelo was treated like a prince, I highly recommend him!
Great experience. Isabella is very sweet and, above all, knowledgeable. See you soon!

Today was my cocker spaniel's first grooming experience, and I couldn't have been more satisfied. The staff were professional, sweet, gentle, and very affectionate, making her feel at ease right away. You can tell they work with passion and love for animals. It was a very positive experience.
Great! I took my two Lagotti to Isabella and they came out great: perfectly clipped and washed. She's very kind and you can tell she's really good. Highly recommended, we'll definitely be back.

We brought our dogs, Ettore and Tea, who, let's say, don't really like baths 😅, but here they were pampered and respected and came away smelling good and happy!!! The use of natural products is noteworthy. The groomers are professional, competent, and attentive. Highly recommended!!! 💗

Today I took my dog ​​to be washed here for the first time and we had a great time! The staff was so sweet, professional, and super attentive. Even our dachshund felt at ease right away. We'll definitely be back. Highly recommended!

I took my 4-month-old poodle Paprika for her first very light grooming, and she immediately felt at home! She was pampered and didn't view this first time as a shock! Isabella and Noemy, you were invaluable! We'll definitely see each other again very often! 🥰 …

I brought my three-year-old Persian cat, Sophie, to this grooming salon for her bath and de-shedding.
Isabella, the groomer, is incredibly sensitive, patient, and professional.
I was very impressed by her ability to connect with my cat, who isn't particularly sociable and is wary.
The use of high-quality, organic products at an affordable price makes this place exceptional.

Thank you, Isabella. From now on, you'll be irreplaceable for us.

Today I took my two cats, Frida and Grisù, for a full grooming session, and the service exceeded my expectations. It was a fun morning, thanks in part to two special cats who enjoyed the various beauty treatments. I'll definitely be back!

Our Borzoi had a rather complex situation regarding knots and hair length. He's a large dog, so finding a place to groom him was equally challenging. Luckily, having already brought our other dog, we already knew who to trust him with. Zar was therefore able to show off his Borzoi style, leaving the grooming room clean, smelling nice, pampered, and of course, as always, flattered and kissed!
The dog was just picked up from the shelter and was immediately made to feel at ease, cuddled, bathed, and perfumed. Excellent.
Best grooming shop in the area! 🥰💖 …

After much research into a groomer for my medium-large dog, Stella, I was immediately satisfied with Isabella's helpfulness and kindness from the first phone call.
You can tell they work with passion and love. Seeing my dog ​​calm and happy is truly worth it.
Approved by Stella ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED 👍🏼🤗
Isabella exudes love for animals. She groomed my tangled kitten with care and gentleness. Seeing her work like this gave me confidence and peace of mind.

Excellent experience! They took wonderful care of Saki, an anxious little dog, giving us back a clean, fragrant creature and successfully freeing her from the terrible knots she had.

Very kind and helpful.
We'll be back soon with our Russian greyhound :D
My Akira had the pleasure of being washed by them, she came home clean, smelling good and super happy, now a trusted groomer.

I had a great experience. It was my first time at this groomer, but I'll definitely be back.
My dog ​​suffers from seizures, and the woman was very helpful, attentive, and caring, despite the difficulties involved.

I was truly thrilled with the experience I had with Isabella...an exceptional person, very empathetic, you can tell she loves her job, even my furry friend liked it and that says it all 🤗🤗...a clean and friendly environment, you can stay there while the dog is being bathed, and I only use natural products. Another important thing is that the owner only sees one appointment at a time to ensure the safety of the dogs!!!! Thanks again, see you next time for a bath 😉😚😚

The "Il Peloso" grooming salon is simply fantastic!
I took my cat Gama for her first bath, and the experience was absolutely wonderful. The girls, Lucia and Isabella, were fabulous: professional, incredibly sweet, and infinitely patient.
Even though Gama was covered in knots, they cared for her with the utmost gentleness and attention, making her feel safe at all times. They complimented my cat so much, saying she looked like a stuffed animal! And the incredible thing is that Gama didn't complain in the slightest, proving how skilled they are at putting even the most fearful furry friends at ease.
The salon is welcoming and well-kept, and you can immediately sense the passion and love for animals that Lucia and Isabella put into their work. A perfect experience, where expertise, patience, and kindness go hand in hand.
Highly recommended to anyone who wants to pamper their four-legged friends with professionals who know how to treat them like true family members! 🐾✨

Isabella is an extraordinary person who takes care of animals with so much love. A friend recommended her to me. I was having trouble finding a groomer because my poodle has serious allergies, and Isabella was excellent at bathing and cutting her hair, meeting my dog's needs. I was so happy. There are no words to express my gratitude, because any words would be insignificant compared to the reality. Congratulations!

I took my big Molosser puppy, Maya, for her first bath an hour ago. It was difficult at first because the naughty girl wanted to go away, but Isabella was super good at managing everything, so much so that in the end she let everything be done, even having her nails and ears trimmed. Now she smells like apples and is all shiny and soft. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED 🔝🔝🔝

The girls here were fantastically empathetic and kind towards our fur baby Mali. Mali is a long-haired Neve Masquerade who absolutely enjoyed the grooming, bath, and drying in a stress free environment. It was such a joy to have had a stress free time getting her groomed.

This morning I took my Trilly for a bath. The bath was done with ozone and vegan products, perfect for Trilly, who is allergic. The two ladies were very kind and professional, and Trilly has a very clean, soft, and shiny coat. I highly recommend them.

I called Isabella and Lucia by chance. I urgently needed to have my mother's poodle groomed. I immediately found them helpful, professional, and passionate, as well as incredibly honest. Fantastic treatment for my furry friend, who after an hour was gorgeous and serene. I highly recommend them. I won't leave them again! Thanks girls ❣️

I brought Kuna a couple of days ago, he needed spurs, defleshing, and a bath. The girls were very efficient, and in two hours they cleaned, bathed, and scented my 60 kg Maremma Sheepdog. I've attached a photo below for confirmation! If they can do this, they can do anything with Kuna! Come, they're wonderful!

We entrusted our dog, Navarro, to "Il Peloso" grooming, and despite our fears that the dog might react too fearfully since it was his first grooming experience, we were more than satisfied! The ladies who run the place, besides being attentive and professional, are very welcoming and cheerful. It was an experience we will remember fondly! We will definitely bring our dog here next time!
Thank you for your trust 🙏🐾 …

REVIEW REPORTED TO GOOGLE. MR. LUCA BIGOTTI HAS NEVER BEEN TO OUR STORE.
THE STAFF 🐾 …

REVIEW REPORTED TO GOOGLE. MR. FERDINANDO REALI HAS NEVER BEEN TO OUR STORE.
THE STAFF 🐾 …
I made an appointment for my dog ​​and I had a great time, they were very good... Blomm is very happy 🐕 …

This morning I called this groomer for my dog ​​Chamille, who needed paw care, ear cleaning, and a good bath. The girls, Isabella and Lucia, were very sweet, kind, and welcoming. They also gave me lots of advice on the dog's care and hygiene. The place isn't very big, but it feels so homey, and my Chamille had a great time with the other dogs. We had such a great time that we'll definitely be back. Thank you so much!

PS: Chamille is super clean and smells amazing 😊

I took my Yorkshire toy dog ​​Milly for a grooming session because her coat and nails were in terrible condition. Milly never lets me touch her, but Isabella gained her trust and let me do everything. I was amazed by the results and how calm and relaxed the Yorkie was. We'll be returning regularly for the care and well-being of our little girl. I recommend them to anyone who owns a furry friend.

I was looking for a groomer that could bathe my Job, a chow chow who's wary but well-behaved. The girls were excellent at both gaining his trust and grooming him. Excellent service at a great price. I highly recommend this place to anyone with a furry friend.

A truly pleasant surprise! The woman is incredibly sweet, helpful, and incredibly skilled with animals. She calms them down and cleans them beautifully with excellent products, which is not a given these days. Helpful, empathetic, and honest, I'll be back very soon. Highly recommended!
We brought our Persian cat, Teddy, and were so touched by the attention and sweetness he received! Thank you ❤️🐈😻 …
I took my dog ​​to the girls and had a great time! They love animals, are clean, kind, and professional! I recommend them 🐾 …
We have just been and met Isabella, a young girl and animal lover, she treated my kitten as if it were her own, very beautiful experience, I absolutely recommend her
